A shifted cohesive-zone method for non-interface-fitted meshes with applications to crystal plasticity

Medium FEA & Surrogate Modelling openalex Transferable Skim only numerical_benchmark
Cheng-Hau Yang, Mark Messner, Tianchen Hu Computer Methods in Applied Mechanics and Engineering 2026-08-04 10.1016/j.cma.2026.119259
单位: Argonne National Laboratory, 9700 S Cass Ave, Lemont, IL 60439, USA
通讯: Cheng-Hau Yang @ Argonne National Laboratory, 9700 S Cass Ave, Lemont, IL 60439, USA
相关性: 该论文提出了一种无需界面匹配网格的移位内聚区方法，其数值方法和网格处理技术可迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模中的网格生成与界面处理问题。
边界: This paper does not address surrogate modeling, uncertainty quantification, or implant/biomechanics design; it focuses on interface mechanics in crystal plasticity with non-interface-fitted meshes.
动机· 解决复杂微结构界面力学模拟中网格生成困难的问题。
方法· 提出移位内聚区方法，将牵引-分离定律从真实界面移至替代界面，并采用PCA增强点分类加速构建。
结果· 在二维和三维基准测试中实现一阶收敛，与界面匹配参考解吻合良好。
验证· 通过二维和三维数值基准测试验证精度和收敛性。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To overcome the meshing burden of interface-conformal discretizations in simulating interface-dominated solid mechanics on complex microstructures.
Method· The Shifted Cohesive Zone Method (SCZM) extends the shifted boundary method to cohesive-zone formulations, shifting traction-separation enforcement to a surrogate interface and using a PCA-enhanced point classification for efficient domain construction.
Result· SCZM achieves first-order convergence and closely matches interface-fitted reference solutions in terms of reaction forces, energy release, stress fields, and damage evolution.
Validation· The method is verified through two- and three-dimensional benchmark problems demonstrating convergence and accuracy.

边界: This paper does not address implant biomechanics (e.g., hip implant stress shielding) nor does it incorporate uncertainty quantification or patient-specific modeling, focusing instead on a colonic stent design with deterministic surrogate-based optimization.
动机· 为满足临时结肠介入的临床需求，设计可回收且刚度可变的支架。
方法· 采用DoE引导有限元模拟，结合RSM和GPR代理模型，用NSGA-II进行多目标优化。

Motivation· To address the clinical need for temporary colonic interventions, a retrievable shape memory polymer stent with variable stiffness is proposed.
Method· A multi-objective optimization framework integrates Design of Experiments-guided finite element simulations with response surface and Gaussian process surrogate models, followed by NSGA-II optimization.
Result· The optimization yielded a Pareto-optimal front clustered into seven design families, offering tailored solutions for distinct clinical scenarios.
Validation· Experimental testing confirmed the accuracy of the surrogate-based optimization framework.

相关性: 该论文研究了SLM制备Ti-6Al-4V的微观结构和力学性能，但未涉及多孔结构、应力遮挡或疲劳性能，与生物医学植入物方向相关性有限。
边界: This paper does not address porous structures, stress shielding, fatigue testing, or surface morphology relevant to biomedical implants; it focuses on the effect of LaB6 addition on microstructure and compressive strength of dense SLM/SPS Ti-6Al-4V.
动机· 比较LaB6添加对SLM和SPS制备Ti-6Al-4V微观结构和力学性能的影响。
方法· 将Ti-6Al-4V粉末与LaB6混合，分别用SLM和SPS制备，并表征微观结构和压缩性能。
结果· SLM样品因快速冷却形成α′马氏体，压缩强度更高；LaB6添加提高屈服强度但降低极限压缩强度。
验证· 通过微观结构观察和压缩力学测试验证。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· This study aims to compare the effects of lanthanum hexaboride addition on the microstructure and mechanical properties of Ti-6Al-4V fabricated by spark plasma sintering and selective laser melting.
Method· Gas-atomized Ti-6Al-4V powders were mixed with LaB6 and consolidated via SPS and SLM, followed by microstructural characterization and compressive testing.
Result· SLM-processed samples exhibited a fully acicular α′ martensitic structure and higher ultimate compressive strength (1920 MPa) compared to SPS (1540 MPa), while LaB6 addition increased yield strength but reduced ultimate compressive strength due to weak interfaces.
Validation· Validation was performed through microstructural analysis and compressive mechanical testing of the fabricated specimens.

动机· 现有器官贴片设计依赖预设结构，难以匹配组织非线性力学响应。

Motivation· Current organ-patch designs rely on predefined architectures and limited descriptors, failing to capture coupled tissue-like mechanical responses.
Method· A diffusion-based inverse design framework integrates a CNN surrogate with an ε-constraint guided reverse diffusion process to generate auxetic metastructure patches matching stress-strain and Poisson's ratio targets.
Result· The surrogate achieves near-perfect R² values, and the framework recovers known geometries and produces alternative designs, demonstrating one-to-many inverse mapping and application-dependent trade-offs.
Validation· Validation uses a finite element dataset for surrogate training, test-set verification, and organ-inspired case studies with secondary FE screening.

Validation· The finite element model was validated against experimental measurements of hardened layer geometry and XRD residual stress, with average agreement exceeding 91%.

Motivation· The coupled GTN fracture model is computationally expensive, hindering its use in large-scale finite element simulations of steel structures.
Method· A two-stage artificial neural network (TS-ANN) is proposed, which decouples material parameter mapping from stress-state dependence, trained on 49,875 single-element GTN simulations.
Result· The TS-ANN achieves a mean absolute error of 0.00143, predicts failure strain within 5% of GTN results for over 99% of data, and reduces computational time by 35-95 times when implemented in ABAQUS.
Validation· The model is validated by comparing predicted fracture displacement in ASTM A992 steel specimens against GTN-based results, showing less than 5% deviation.

Motivation· To simultaneously optimize compressive residual stress magnitude and depth in ultrasonic surface rolling of Ti-6Al-4V, which is challenging due to complex elastic-plastic behavior.
Method· An integrated analytical-statistical framework combining Hertzian contact theory, energy-based dynamic impact analysis, and Grey-Taguchi multi-response optimization was developed.

Method· A comparative-statics model parameterizes the resource allocation between the two approaches and incorporates scale-dependent degradation and fragility, with closed-form expected harm and Monte Carlo CVaR analysis.
Result· The optimal allocation shifts toward character shaping with scale, but the dominant factor is the baseline character fragility rate, not scale or tail severity.
Validation· The model is validated through Monte Carlo simulations across three scenarios, comparing expected harm and CVaR optima.

Motivation· To efficiently design graded mechanical metamaterials under finite-bandwidth stochastic excitations by overcoming high computational cost and high-dimensional design spaces.
Method· The framework integrates a multiregion Craig-Bampton component mode synthesis with PCA/kriging surrogate for reduced-order matrices, a state-space stochastic excitation model solved via Lyapunov equation, and Bayesian optimization over low-dimensional grading parameters.
Result· The surrogate accurately predicts stochastic performance, revealing a trade-off between performance and computational cost, and showing that optimal grading depends on excitation bandwidth.
Validation· Validation is performed through a numerical benchmark on a 2D metamaterial, comparing surrogate predictions against high-fidelity FE results.

相关性: 该论文为临床回顾性研究，未涉及多孔结构设计、LPBF制造或力学测试，与增材制造生物医学材料方向无直接关联。
边界: This paper does not cover porous structure design, LPBF fabrication, mechanical testing, or fatigue analysis; it is purely a clinical outcome study of commercial implants.

英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To provide clinical evidence for nanostructured calcium-incorporated titanium dental implants, which have shown promising preclinical biological activity but lack long-term clinical validation.
Method· A retrospective observational study analyzed 753 implants with 24-124 months follow-up, using Kaplan-Meier survival analysis and linear/spline regression to assess marginal bone loss progression.
Result· The cumulative survival rate was 99.6% with only three failures, and marginal bone loss increased minimally at 0.016 mm/year, indicating stable long-term bone remodeling.
Validation· Clinical validation through retrospective analysis of patient records and radiographs from a university dental hospital.
